decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The demolition of existing conservatory and erection of a single storey rear infill extension with replacement rear window at first floor level and side window on ground floor of house, as shown on drawing number 0566/2, 0566/3, 0566/4A, 0566/5, 0566/6A, 0566/7, 0566/8A, 0566/9, 0566/10, 0566/11, 0566/12A, 0566/13, 0566/14 & 0566/15A, received 1 September 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would satisfactorily maintain the street scene. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development, H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance
